speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Patient
text: The sinus symptoms improved, but the flank pain and fever stayed. The rash happened during the antibiotics and then resolved after the change in medication. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear as a new symptom or was it a reaction to the antibiotics you received? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count; REQUEST TEST: Renal_Function_Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: NORMAL READINGS; Renal_Function_Panel: Elevated Urea, Elevated Creatinine

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated creatinine and urea suggest acute kidney injury, possibly due to the rash which could be a serum sickness-like reaction or a drug-induced interstitial nephritis. Did you experience any redness or pain when urinating, or have you seen any blood in your urine? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy
